Pendle is a yield trading protocol on public blockchains. Pendle splits yield-bearing assets into principal tokens and yield tokens. Pendle lets users trade fixed and variable yield exposure before maturity.

Rocket Pool is a decentralized liquid staking protocol for Ethereum. Rocket Pool issues the rETH token to stakers. Rocket Pool allows node operators to run validators with a smaller ETH bond alongside RPL collateral.

Wormhole is a cross-chain messaging and interoperability protocol connecting multiple blockchains. Wormhole relies on a guardian network of validators that sign cross-chain messages. Wormhole enables token transfers between supported blockchains.

Kelp DAO is a liquid restaking protocol built on EigenLayer. Kelp DAO issues the rsETH liquid restaking token to depositors. Kelp DAO lets users restake supported assets while keeping liquidity.

Balancer is an automated market maker decentralized exchange on public blockchains. Balancer supports weighted pools and stable pools with multiple tokens per pool. Balancer uses a vault architecture that centralizes pool token balances and governs protocol changes through its BAL token.
